article.headline: Smiley puts up 18, Belmont takes down Union (KY) 86-44
article.description: — Jack Smiley had 18 points in Belmont’s 86-44 win over Union (KY) on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Smiley puts up 18, Belmont takes down Union (KY) 86-44
article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. ( -- — Jack Smiley had 18 points in Belmont’s 86-44 win over Union (KY) on Wednesday. Smiley shot 7 for 12, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc for the Bruins (4-1). Cooper Haynes scored eight points and added five rebounds. Vincent Neugebauer shot 4 of 6 from the field to finish with eight points. Ali Sakho led the way for the Bulldogs with 14 points and six rebounds. Union (KY) also got eight points from Jabari Covington. John Carreker finished with eight points. Belmont took the lead with 19:33 left in the first half and did not trail again. Smiley led their team in scoring with 15 points in the first half to help put them up 39-20 at the break. Belmont extended its lead to 57-22 during the second half, fueled by an 18-0 scoring run. Matthew Zobrist scored a team-high eight points in the second half as their team closed out the win. Up next Belmont plays Monday against Yale, and Union (KY) visits Miami (OH) on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
